visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with black hair and gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a white t-shirt with light blue accents, smiles at the camera and raises her right index finger in an indoor room with beige walls and a dark shelf. (2) The camera pans left to show a compact black stroller sitting on a grey carpeted floor; a hand enters the frame from the right, pointing at the stroller. (3) The view shifts to show a miniature cream-colored electric toy car styled like a vintage convertible Porsche, parked next to the strollers in what appears to be a garage. (4) The camera pans to reveal a second, larger stroller with a blue seat and black frame, with the hand still pointing to highlight the object against a background of boxes. (5) A grey wagon-style double stroller with a sun canopy and a large handle is shown parked against the wall, next to more storage containers and household items. (6) The camera moves to show a small pink three-wheeled tricycle with a white basket and a tall steering handle for parents, tucked into the corner of the gear area. (7) A wide-angle shot reveals the entire collection of five baby vehicles lined up in the garage, showing the scale of the accumulation, while skateboards are visible on a wall rack to the right.
